findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agiliron_list_tickets · Private data: agiliron_list_contacts, agiliron_list_notes, agiliron_add_lead, agiliron_update_lead, agiliron_add_contact, agiliron_update_contact, agiliron_add_account, agiliron_update_account, agiliron_add_task, agiliron_update_task, agiliron_add_note · Public sink: agiliron_add_lead, agiliron_add_contact, agiliron_add_account, agiliron_add_task, agiliron_add_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agiliron_list_tickets · Private data: agiliron_list_contacts, agiliron_list_notes, agiliron_add_lead, agiliron_update_lead, agiliron_add_contact, agiliron_update_contact, agiliron_add_account, agiliron_update_account, agiliron_add_task, agiliron_update_task, agiliron_add_note · Public sink: agiliron_add_lead, agiliron_add_contact, agiliron_add_account, agiliron_add_task, agiliron_add_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
